name: Hardware Wallet Security
description: Security enforcement power for KeyWallet. Bundles the security steering document, MCP tools for transaction inspection and devnet queries, and the Crypto Security Reviewer agent.

mcpServers.name: key-wallet-mcp
mcpServers.description: Provides inspect_transaction and query_devnet tools for inspecting Solana transactions and querying devnet without exposing private keys.

agents.name: Crypto Security Reviewer
agents.description: Reviews cryptographic code for violations of the four KeyWallet security rules.

securityRules: No PRF_Output or private key bytes written to disk
Zero-overwrite secret buffers immediately after use
Use platform CSPRNG only (node:crypto.randomBytes or crypto.getRandomValues)
